title: PrairieRx Maternity Rider — OTC Allowance Carry-Over Share
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — rider for members in the Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care category.** When a benefit quarter of the over-the-counter allowance closes, part of its unused allowance may be retained on the allowance balance into the next quarter. The carry-over share is the fraction of the carry-over base that is retained.

**Rule.** The carry-over share is one half (0.5) for a member whose active plan membership is Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care and who has at least 4 paid preventive claims with a service date in the six months before the forfeiture is booked; one quarter (0.25) for a Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care member with at least 2 but fewer than 4 such claims; and nothing for any other member.

### What the rule reads

- **The member's active plan membership** — the Medicaid Managed Care Membership in active status and its plan eligibility category.
- **Paid preventive claims** — claims booked on that Medicaid Managed Care Membership whose service category is preventive and whose adjudication status is paid, with a service date within the six months before the day the forfeiture is booked.

### Share table

| Active membership category | Paid preventive claims in the six months before booking | Carry-over share |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 4 or more | One half (0.5) |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 2 or 3 | One quarter (0.25) |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | 0 or 1 | Nothing |
| Any other category | any number | Nothing |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care member with exactly 4 such claims reaches the upper tier: one half.
- The same member with 3 claims is in the middle tier: one quarter.
- With exactly 2 claims the member is still in the middle tier; with 1 claim no share applies.
- A preventive claim that is denied, or whose service date is more than six months before the booking day, is not counted.

### What the share governs

The retained carry-over is the carry-over share of the carry-over base, limited to the quarter's unused allowance — the amount loaded for the closed quarter less every purchase tagged to it, never below zero. The retained carry-over stays on the allowance balance into the next quarter, and the forfeiture booked for the closed quarter is the quarter's unused allowance less the retained carry-over; only that forfeiture is rounded to the cent.

*Where no carry-over share applies,* nothing is retained under this rider, and the whole unused allowance of the closed quarter is forfeited.
